records.title: FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation
records.reason: Interactive scientific-figure explanation, no inference-resource method.

records.title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
records.reason: Perspective-taking capability method, no model-cost optimization.

records.title: ALF: Spectrally Anchored Latent Flow Matching
records.reason: Wireless time-series generation, outside LLM/VLM serving scope.

records.title: Ceiling of a Task: When Can a Transformer Succeed Without Its Chain of Thought?
records.reason: The paper treats CoT as serial computation and tests when Transformers cannot solve tasks without it, including MATH-500/AIME; erasing chains hurts serial-task accuracy. Relevant to reasoning-token cost decisions, but establishes limits rather than a resource-reduction method.

records.title: Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers
records.reason: Mechanistic study of two looped-Transformer variants on iteration, finite-state composition and graph traversal; it finds distinct recurrence algorithms and reliability degradation with depth. It informs looped reasoning but offers no compute/memory/latency optimization.
